notes: New: returns from customers. Turn on Returns from customers in Settings, then open a sale and tap Return items: the goods go back in stock (or are written off if damaged) and the customer gets the money back in cash, by bank, or off their account. Fixed: a bill with a discount on an item now prints that discount on the item and adds up; only the bill's own discount shows under the subtotal. The logo and signature now travel with a backup. Reports show only the profit lines that hold something. History says what a payment was for (Paid to supplier for PUR-...), and a supplier's page shows the discount on its bills. Settings offers a one-time fix for lots bought at a discount before 1.18. Also since 1.16: a mobile number on every bill, Cash or Bank everywhere, Cash and Bank history, the business report as PDF, Excel or CSV, and expenses paid from Outside.
